name: Cloudflare Zero Trust & Security
description: Zero Trust Tunnels, DNS management, and WAF security controls with instant audit rollback for xConsole.
author: xConsole Team

agentTools.name: cloudflare_list_zones
agentTools.description: List all DNS zones / domains in the connected Cloudflare account.

agentTools.name: cloudflare_get_zone_analytics
agentTools.description: Get real-time web traffic analytics, HTTP requests, bandwidth, cache hits, and security threats for a Cloudflare domain/zone.

since_minutes.description: Optional: time window in minutes (-1440 for 24h, -60 for 1h)

agentTools.name: cloudflare_list_tunnels
agentTools.description: List all Cloudflare Zero Trust / Argo tunnels for a Cloudflare cloud account.

agentTools.name: cloudflare_list_dns
agentTools.description: List DNS records for a given Cloudflare zone (domain).

agentTools.name: cloudflare_upsert_dns
agentTools.description: Create or update a DNS record in Cloudflare.

record_id.description: Optional: specify to update existing record

agentTools.name: cloudflare_set_security_level
agentTools.description: Set Cloudflare security level for a zone ('essentially_off', 'low', 'medium', 'high', 'under_attack').

agentTools.name: cloudflare_get_history
agentTools.description: Get recent Cloudflare configuration edits and actions made to DNS, tunnels, or security levels.

agentTools.name: cloudflare_revert_action
agentTools.description: Automatically revert / roll back a previous Cloudflare modification using its history action ID.

action_id.description: ID of the audit log action to revert
